title: Meta Spent $100B to $200B on AI Infrastructure Before Proof of Success

tickers.name: Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Mark Zuckerberg disclosed that the company’s pursuit of artificial intelligence relied on massive capital bets with uncertain returns. Meta spent between $100 billion and $200 billion on infrastructure last year to power its AI products before the company had any idea whether the investments would eventually succeed.

The investment led to the release of the Muse Wonder AI model and the Muse Personal Assistant. However, Zuckerberg stated that consumer adoption rates and the overall revenue potential for these tools remain unclear.
